headline: Our editorial board weighs in on ballot measures and propositions. Now it’s your turn to decide.
summary: Sara Rubin here, with a suggestion to check your mailbox to see if you’ve received a mail-in ballot yet. If you’re a registered voter in Monterey County, odds are good that it has already arrived. Various opportunities to return that
